home.title: Home
home.description: Your location, speed, accident risk, and weather will appear here.

map.title: Map
map.description: Your position, road details, and risky roads will appear here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your details, emergency contacts, and driving stats will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Alert, voice, unit, and privacy preferences will appear here.
settings.restartHint: Switching to or from Arabic restarts the app.

safety.reportDescription: The accident report form will appear here.

errors.watch: Could not read your location. Check location services and try again.
errors.permission: Could not check location access. Try again.

permission.servicesOffBody: Turn on location services for your device so OSY can follow your position and speed.
permission.requestBody: OSY uses your location and speed while the app is open to warn you about road risks. Motion access helps it notice a crash.
permission.deniedBody: OSY cannot show your position or speed without location access.
permission.limitedBody: OSY is using your approximate location, so speed and road details may be wrong.
permission.motionRequestBody: Motion access helps OSY notice a crash. Location still works without it.
permission.motionDeniedBody: Location still works, but OSY will not be able to use motion to notice a crash.

crash_detected.title: Possible crash detected
crash_detected.body: Are you OK? Open OSY to respond.

potential_accident.title: Accident risk ahead
potential_accident.body: Slow down and take extra care.

accident_nearby.title: Accident nearby
accident_nearby.body: Someone may need help. Open OSY for details.

permission.requestBody: OSY uses notifications to warn you about road risks and reach you after a crash.
permission.deniedBody: OSY cannot warn you when the app is closed unless notifications are on.

checkIn.title: Are you OK?
checkIn.stillWaiting: We haven’t heard from you yet.
checkIn.sharedTitle: If you need help, OSY will share:
checkIn.escalatedTitle: We could not confirm you’re OK
checkIn.escalatedBody: OSY has not contacted anyone yet. If you need help, call emergency services yourself.

api.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
api.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
api.conflict: This information is already in use.
api.validation: Check the highlighted information and try again.
api.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
api.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
api.request: The request could not be completed.
api.invalid_response: The server sent an unexpected response.
